These older papers may not be on arXiv and would require Google Scholar or DBLP retrieval.
- **RL-based citation traversal**: No boundary query (eby-01) results included here — handled separately by other scouts.
- **Closed-source Deep Research evaluations**: em-02 surfaced PaperQA2 (open-source) but did not surface proprietary Deep Research evaluations; the commercial systems (OpenAI, Gemini, Perplexity) are not arXiv-published.
